Find it before it finds you

Take the night shift in a haunted archive. Study photographic evidence, listen to recovered recordings and classify what should not be there. As the cases unfold, watch the office around you.

  • Seven shifts and five active endings.
  • Photographic, audio, document and object evidence.
  • Hands-on 3D inspection, physical clues and hidden archive secrets.
  • Recovered cassette recordings and telephone briefings.
  • Unsettling office encounters.
  • Optional subtitles and adjustable Potato-to-Ultra graphics.

Windows requirements

64-bit Windows 10 or 11, DirectX 11-capable graphics, keyboard and mouse. Allow at least 3 GB for the installed game and additional space for downloads and updates. Headphones recommended. Internet is needed for purchases, sign-in, installation and updates. Minimum CPU, RAM and GPU performance has yet to be benchmarked across hardware.

Purchases and access

Released 7 November 2026. Buy the game for {{price}} in Workshop Launcher. Once payment is confirmed, install it from Library. Your purchase stays linked to your verified Workshop account for reinstalling and future updates.

itch.io buyers can request optional Workshop Launcher access without buying again. The Workshop verifies the itch.io purchase before issuing a private one-use code.

For order help, contact Workshop support or open a private ticket in the official Workshop Discord. Refund requests follow the applicable store rules and your statutory rights.

How it works

TrapDoor creates a clearly warned honeypot channel. A non-exempt account that posts in it is automatically banned and the action is recorded in a private moderation log.

TrapDoor runs without Discord’s Message Content privileged intent. It reacts to the presence of a message in the configured channel and stores no message content in its own database.

Commands

  • /honeypot setup
  • /honeypot status
  • /honeypot enable
  • /honeypot disable
  • /honeypot warning
  • /honeypot test
  • /honeypot exempt-add
  • /honeypot exempt-remove
  • /honeypot exempt-list
  • /support
  • /about

/honeypot test checks configuration, channel access, permissions, logging, role hierarchy and warning-message management without banning a member.

Automatic exemptions

The server owner, bots, webhooks, members with Administrator or Ban Members, and explicitly exempt roles are ignored.
